The budget check reads the committed toolsnap JSON, not the built binary, so a description change is invisible to it until the snapshot is regenerated.\n\nConsequence: the order matters. After any tool-description edit, run toolsnap --update BEFORE skill_lint, or the lint judges the old text. run_ci_gates.py runs them in ci.yml's order (skill_lint before toolsnap), so it has the same blind spot within one run on a stale snapshot.
